name: Tennō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tennō town emblem in white: a stylised device of two facing crescents joined by horizontal bars.
history: Flag of the former town of Tennō in Akita Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1961.

features.role: Tennō town emblem — a stylised device of two facing crescents joined by horizontal bars
